verdict.rationale: Polar publishes a versioned OpenAPI 3.1.0 spec served keylessly from the docs site (confirmed live by probe), official typed SDKs, llms.txt/agent-legible docs, webhooks following Standard Webhooks spec, and a sandbox for testing — giving AI-native users a fully documented, machine-readable public API surface to drive the product programmatically. missing for 10: independent third-party corroboration (e.g. community integration reports) beyond first-party docs and probes.
